chunks: Verily the worst of creatures in the sight of God are those who deny (the truth), and will not believe.

key_terms.الدَّوَابِّ: Creatures or beasts (specifically moving creatures on earth)

ai.seo_question: Who are considered the worst of creatures in Islam according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted to denote a state of spiritual stagnation where disbelievers, despite possessing the faculty of reason, fail to utilize it for recognizing divine truth, rendering them 'worse than livestock' (al-dawabb). The term 'sharr al-dawabb' implies a degradation of status below mere animals, as they lack the instinctual obedience that even beasts show to their Creator. This highlights the Shia emphasis on the active use of intellect (aql) as a prerequisite for true faith.
